review_candidates.title: Senior Research Infrastructure and Cloud Engineer Ref: 44390
review_candidates.description_excerpt: You'll provide technical leadership for the specialist compute, storage and cloud platforms that support research across the University, ensuring they remain reliable, scalable, secure and capable of meeting increasingly demanding research requirements.
eligibility_evidence: Working as part of a small specialist team, you'll lead the design, implementation and operation of research infrastructure including High Performance Computing (HPC), large-scale research data storage, alongside private and hybrid cloud environments.

This role operates on a hybrid basis and will normally involve working on campus at least three days per week, typically Tuesday to Thursday, reflecting the importance of face-to-face engagement with colleagues and stakeholders.
Sussex is a renowned, multi-accredited, research-led International University and this is only possible because of the people that work here.
Eligibility Visa Sponsorship Queries: This role may be eligible for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: You'll provide technical leadership for the specialist compute, storage and cloud platforms that support research across the University, ensuring they remain reliable, scalable, secure and capable of meeting increasingly demanding research requirements. While they focus on research platforms, software, data services and researcher-facing capabilities, you'll provide expertise and leadership in the underlying infrastructure that enables those services. About You You'll be an experienced infrastructure engineer with strong technical expertise and a passion for enabling research through technology. You'll be comfortable balancing hands-on technical work with technical leadership, helping to shape infrastructure architecture and future direction while remaining actively involved in engineering and operational delivery.
